entities.summary: Bishop Dmytro Bohdan Hryhorak, O.S.B.M. is a Ukrainian Greek Catholic hierarch as an Eparchial Bishop of Buchach since 23 July 2011. Previously he served as an Apostolic Administrator of the same Eparchy from 28 July 2007 until 21 July 2011.
